definitions.name: S0A.PICK
definitions.body: 'T' BIND 'F' BIND 'X' BIND X F 2 COLLECT 0 1 T SELECT GET
definitions.note: x y t -> x when t is TRUE else y; safe for Vectors of any length

definitions.name: S0A.OR
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A NOT B NOT AND NOT
definitions.note: a b -> logical OR of two truth values

definitions.name: S0A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'L' BIND A A LENGTH 1 SUB E L 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT A E 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT L 0 GET E EQ S0A.PICK
definitions.note: FOLD step: extend a run-length list [[v c]...] with one element

definitions.name: S0A.RLE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ S0A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector -> run-length encoding [[value count]...]

definitions.name: S0A.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 2 GET 'B' BIND A 1 GET 1 ADD 1 E A 0 GET GT SELECT 'C' BIND E C B C MAX 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [prev cur best] for longest strictly increasing stretch

definitions.name: S0A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 0 0 3 COLLECT [ S0A.UPSTEP ] FOLD 2 GET
definitions.note: Vector -> length of longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: S0A.DDSTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A A E 1 COLLECT CONCAT A -1 GET E EQ S0A.PICK
definitions.note: FOLD step: append element unless equal to last

definitions.name: S0A.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET 1 COLLECT [ S0A.DDSTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector with adjacent duplicates collapsed

definitions.name: S0A.SECOND
definitions.body: UNIQUE SORT 'U' BIND U -2 GET NIL U LENGTH 1 GT SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> second-largest distinct value, or NIL

definitions.name: S0A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V SORT V LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET 'C' BIND V [ C EQ ] FILTER LENGTH 2 MUL V LENGTH GT 'T' BIND C NIL T SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: S0A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV 'Q' BIND Q Q FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: n -> ascending Vector of positive divisors of n

definitions.name: S0A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'M' BIND 1 M RANGE [ S0A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: n -> ascending Vector of primes <= n

definitions.name: S0A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 0 5 RANGE [ 'K' BIND 2 K POW ] MAP [ N GT NOT ] FILTER REVERSE 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR JOIN
definitions.note: n (1..63) -> base-2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: S0A.CZSTEP
definitions.body: 'I' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'X' BIND A 1 GET 'S' BIND X 2 DIV 'H' BIND H X 3 MUL 1 ADD H H FLOOR EQ SELECT 'Y' BIND X 1 EQ 'D' BIND X Y D SELECT S S 1 ADD D SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [x steps] applying one Collatz step until x is 1

definitions.name: S0A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 150 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ S0A.CZSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: n (small) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (up to 150)

definitions.name: S0A.DROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'M' BIND M M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
definitions.note: n >= 1 -> digital root

definitions.name: S0A.FIBINDEX
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 12 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'I' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 GET A 0 GET A 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: n (<= 144) -> smallest k with F(k) >= n

definitions.name: S0A.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ C '[' EQ S0A.OR SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> maximum nesting depth

definitions.name: S0A.RED
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT [ 'Z' ] A CONCAT -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'P' BIND P '()' EQ P '[]' EQ S0A.OR S0A.PICK
definitions.note: FOLD step: push a bracket char, or pop when it closes the matching top ("()" or "[]")

definitions.name: S0A.BALANCED
definitions.body: CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] FOLD [ ] EQ
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly nested and matched

definitions.name: S0A.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] SCAN 'S' BIND [ [ ] ] S CONCAT 'T' BIND 0 S LENGTH RANGE [ 'I' BIND T I GET [ ] EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: S0A.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] FOLD LENGTH
definitions.note: bracket String -> characters left after deleting matched pairs repeatedly
